CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_FACTLOANSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE  @Businessdate VARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN


WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance  WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND @Businessdate BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
, Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCAB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCAB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCAB.CustomerAccountId
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,BalanceAmount
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

 SELECT
 @Businessdate AS BusinessDateSK
 ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
 ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BCAB.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
 ,CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCAB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BCAB.BalanceAmount End AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
 ,CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCAB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT ELSE BCAB.BalanceAmount / DCA.CNT END AS TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
 ,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
 FROM 
 CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCAB
 LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAB.CustomerAccountId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerAccountId)
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1 
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID  AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
 LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAB.PeriodStartDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
 LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId
 WHERE @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure)



END
